integrity: All claimed formulas follow from an explicit unitary coordinate permutation and exact 2x2 singular values; finite checks supplement, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Diagonal couplings and the unilateral shift pair only; two-sided unitary equivalence is not similarity. Independent assessment and exhaustive publication-priority checks not performed.
title: Exact singular spectrum and sharp conditioning of diagonal positive couplings of a shift pair
